standard.summary: 逗号分隔的触发词列表或文件路径。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: A comma-separated list of trigger words, or a file path.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 逗号分隔的触发词列表或文件路径。每个 batch 随机选一个注入到 caption 中

advanced_en.principle: Comma-separated trigger-word list or a file path. One is randomly picked per batch and injected into the caption.
